audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side are all 'Skill' with Alistar-favoring .why text, but content win[0..6] are all 'Vel'Koz' and packet.levelChart is also all Vel'Koz across all 7 rows. The two layers directly contradict each other on who wins every stage of lane.
audit.why: win[N] already reads 'Vel'Koz' for all seven rows and matches packet.levelChart, so per the chart rule this is the case where content is already correct and only the full layer (side, rating, why) needs to move — no win[N] edit needed since it would be a no-op.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to 'Vel'Koz', adjusted phases[N].rating down to reflect Vel'Koz favor throughout, and rewrote each .why to state the real reason (his range/poke/true-damage kit) instead of the old Alistar-favoring text.

audit.why: spikes[] correctly identify level 2 (Plasma Fission poke before you close), level 6 (Unbreakable Will answers Life Form Disintegration Ray), first item (mobility lets you flash-engage through poke), and late (Tectonic Disruption into R deletes carries) — all grounded in real ability names and mechanics.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged that Vel'Koz's true damage (Organic Deconstruction (P) stacks, and Life Form Disintegration Ray (R) converting to true damage) bypasses armor/MR entirely, and this fact was absent from the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'resistances-invalidated' applies directly and was unstated.
audit.corrected: Replaced the copy-paste-bled dosFull[1].d with the true-damage/resistances-invalidated fact.

edits.before: Trade autos behind the roar sustain — the cow chips politely until level 2 changes religions.
edits.after: Vel'Koz out-ranges every auto with Plasma Fission poke — you eat chip just walking to minions.

edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.
edits.after: Void Rift adds burst poke — his Q-W chunks you before your W-Q ever gets in range.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: Tectonic Disruption's knockup punishes your engage — his rotation chunks every step in.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: His sustained E-Q-W poke out-ranges your zero-range kit at every step.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.
edits.after: Life Form Disintegration Ray adds burst — his R punishes any mistimed engage from range.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.
edits.after: First item, his poke damage scales faster than your durability closes it.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.
edits.after: Late his combo threatens to delete your carry from range — he dictates every fight.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Organic Deconstruction (P) and his R deal true damage — armor and MR don't stop the burst; out-position it instead.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Trading chip damage into full Q-W-E poke — his true-damage stacks punish patience, not aggression.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. It writes your spacing rules. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption (E) is down 12s at rank 1, 10s at max — dodge it and the true-damage rotation stalls that long. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
